column1: # Supplement to verdict_ledger.tsv: tournaments that five voters can produce but not with
# unit margin, which Section 6.7 of the manuscript counts and which the ledger cannot hold,
# because the ledger is keyed on registry.tsv and the registry indexes catalogue families.
# These seventeen are derived tournaments: the fifteen one-arc reversals of the 21-vertex
# vertex-transitive tournaments C_a (h01, all ten arc orbits) and C_b (h02, orbits 0, 2, 5,
# 6 and 9) that remain unit-margin obstructions (Appendix I), Paley(23) minus a vertex, and
# Paley(23) with one arc reversed (Section 6.3).  Written by hand, not by verdict_ledger.py.
# The first eight columns are the ledger's.  `host` is the tournament, `unit_cover` the
# complete unit-margin search (slices:ARCHIVE:HOST, slice logs that must tile the base-state
# range; times:FILE:N, a per-base-state record that must list 0..N-1), and
# `majority_witness` the five orders (ARCHIVE:MEMBER for a file inside an archive).
# tools/check_manuscript.py adds these rows to the ledger's when it re-counts Section 6.7;
# verify/separation_supplement.py re-derives every row from those files, and
# tools/check_package.sh check 8l runs it with three negative controls.
